## Workload

During the review period, grader Daniel Roche completed 935 reads over 488 hours. This represents a rate of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed as part of the quarterly assessment, with the recorded activity providing the basis for consideration of throughput and consistency. The figures indicate the volume of work undertaken and the time recorded for its completion.

## Quality

A total of 64 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 78.1 per cent. The review considered the consistency of the grading decisions and identified borderline background cases for feedback. This feedback was provided to support consistent handling of cases that required closer consideration.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
